_comment: stationer_room_loop + invrisil_v016_gate_check's start (FIXTURE-FIRST). Copied from boulevard_night_footpads_start -- the shipped, geared, level-10 Invrisil position that already carries the whole monotone chain test_fixture_coherence enforces (door_awakened/door_mounted/dig chain, riverfarm_attuned + blight_lifted + invrisil_attuned with the stone in inventory), the full POST_GAME_BACKBONE (near_invrisil itself only passes that by a name-keyed exemption) and melee_hit 57, which is what warrior L10's own `requires` asks for. Stands on invrisil_boulevard at (20,2), the cell invrisil_walkthrough observes the stationer's facade from, facing up into the new door at (20,1) -- row 1 is blocked end to end, so the bump that opens this script sets facing without moving and the door opens on interact. `observe` is added to player_skills as the QA-fixture-only grant near_invrisil already establishes (no shipped class grants [Appraise Foe] this early): the interior's three non-quest observes are the point of the loop. actions_since_sleep 45 puts the run at DUSK so the stationer's dust_motes ambience and its sconce pool are live in the windowed read; the boulevard's two night encounters sit behind encounter_when phase:[night] and are still shut at dusk. rng_state is seed 9's derived state (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd), never hand-typed; no fight resolves here, so it is inert.
